recipes.name: Arugula Fennel Salad
ingredients_raw: 2 small fennel bulbs, cored and thinly sliced

steps.text: Make the dressing: Whisk oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt together in a small bowl.
Make the salad: Combine arugula, fennel, tomatoes, Parmesan, and pine nuts in a large salad bowl. Drizzle dressing over top and toss to coat.

raw_recipe.headline: Arugula Fennel Salad
raw_recipe.description: This peppery arugula and sweet fennel salad is topped with toasted pine nuts and Parmesan, then tossed a tangy lemon dressing.

review.reviewBody: After experiencing (and loving!) a Stilton/fennel salad at a local restaurant - I quickly went and bought 5 fennels- with no idea how to make it. This was a crunchy and rich recipe I'll be adding to the recipe book. I also made a version with romaine lettuce instead of arugula and added a little white balsamic- refreshing!!!! Thanks Chrissiek:)
Added a tablespoon of honey to reduce tartness. Also, I used parmesan reggiano cheese and shaved it with a vegetable peeler off the block rather than grate it. Not one bite was left.

The first time I made this my husband and I were hooked. We're on a budget but we "splurge" (relative term) on the fennel and arugula for this. I've also made it with kale which doesn't have quite the bold flavor but is still good.

I also sometimes top this one with a dressing of sherry vinegar (or lemon juice) + walnut oil + salt/pepper, which is an awesome combo. We make this at least a couple of times per month. Thanks for sharing!!
I really liked this but next time would go a little easier on the salt and use romaine.

My first time using fennel. Really yummy salad, that looked great too. I followed the recipe except substituted cashews for the pine nuts, since I forgot them at the grocery store. I will make this again and again. I think the point nights will be better. The next night I made it with mandarin oranges and grapes, omitting the tomatoes. This was good too.

This is a winner! ! Did this salad as a side and got high ratings - even from a guy! My grocery store only had a baby spinach and arugula mix but that seemed to work well. My only other change was that I shaved bigger chunks of parmesan versus grating it. The little cherry tomatoes added nice sweetness to balance the tang. Definitely will be making again!

Amazing salad! I've taken this to two dinner parties and everyone was raving about it and asking for the recipe (and it's hard to wow people with salad!). The fennel and arugula are great together but the real winner is the dressing (such fresh flavor...would be good on any salad). I did make one change...I added 2 tsp of honey because it was a little too tart for my taste. But the flavor was great even without the honey and some may like it really tart.

This salad was so delicious! I just love the lemon dressing and how well all these ingredients taste together. I took this on three occasions to work for lunch, adding the lemon dressing the night before each time. The arugula and tomatoes soak up all the dressing, and the fennel stays crisp. Don't forget the Parmesan, as it really ties in all of the flavors beautifully. Thanks for a great recipe!

I followed the recipe and was delighted. We ate Italian food with and it was a fresh, exciting, new surprise to my palate. The flavors beautifully complemented our food and the entire family enjoyed it!

I have a lot of arugula in my garden, so I was looking for a good salad, and this is absolutely incredible! I’ve never tried fennel bulbs, and they were a tasty addition. This is my favorite salad ever!
This was a different, delicious salad. Was tired of the same 3 or 4 salads I usually make . It was a huge success!
I omitted the olive oil for a no-fat version, and it was still delicious.
Delicious and refreshing! This ended up making salad for the hubs and me for three nights. It was a nice change from the usual lettuce salad. I will definitely be making it again!
Delicious! Nice light addition to a heavier meal. Would definitely make it again!
Delicious! I will make it again!
Super delicious! Ended up also adding feta cheese and chicken breast.
Made a few modifications to suite my taste -- I added orange slices and left out nuts. This recipe made for a great base to build upon.
